summary: Kinsale Capital Group filed an 8-K under Items 5.02 and 8.01 reporting the retirement of EVP and CIO Diane Schnupp and the promotion of Salmaan Allibhai to EVP, Chief Analytics and Technology Officer, effective April 29, 2026. No financial terms, premiums, or shareholder votes are involved. The event is a routine executive transition with no acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation mechanisms. No deal terms apply. Watch for normal succession and operational continuity.
